nosotros.title: About us
nosotros.seoTitle: About us | El Ancla Baptist Church
nosotros.description: Learn who we are, what we believe, and how we live the faith as El Ancla Baptist Church in Montevideo.

hero.standfirst: Getting to know a church is a real challenge in these times. We hope the information here helps you understand who we are, what we believe, and how we have lived the faith in Montevideo since 1997.

featuredImage.alt: Home of El Ancla Baptist Church in Montevideo
featuredImage.label: [ FIG.01 ]
featuredImage.caption: Church house · Av. Dr. Luis A. de Herrera 3101 corner of Juan Arrieta.

paragraphs: We are a Baptist Christian community in the heart of Montevideo. For almost three decades we have gathered around the Word, the sacraments, and prayer. We are not a perfect church — and we do not pretend to be — but we do want to be an honest church, trying to live the gospel in ordinary life.

Our name comes from Hebrews 6:19: "we have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure." That image says a lot about us: ordinary people holding on to what sustains us when circumstances move.

blocks.text: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure, entering the inner sanctuary behind the curtain.

sections.description: A church is not defined only by what it says it believes, but by what orders its life. These are the three convictions that shape almost everything we do in practice.

values.title: Centered on Christ
values.description: The cross and resurrection are not topics among others: they are the center of our preaching, singing, and pastoral care.

values.title: Faithful to the Word
values.description: The Scriptures are our final authority for doctrine and practice. That is why we preach whole texts, not isolated verses.

values.title: Family of faith
values.description: We grow together in hospitality, service, and prayer. Faith is learned by walking with others, not alone.

note.label: Note · Confession
note.html: If you want to read in detail what we believe, we wrote a Statement of Faith organized in twelve articles. It is the longer and more careful version of what we summarize here in three words.

sections.description: The story of El Ancla fits into one avenue and a few families who decided to stay. These milestones shaped who we are today.

paragraphs: The {name} ministry exists to accompany the church through a concrete form of service. Today we leave a simple, ordered base for publishing its purpose, activities, leaders, and next steps.
The intention is that every ministry page can evolve from typed data: content is added to the record and the template handles the design, index, images, links, and mobile experience.
